OPTIMIZATION-BASED REPRESENTATIONS
Optimization approaches concepts as outcomes of objectives optimized under constraints. Concepts
emerge because they support efficient prediction, decision making, communication, compression,
or other task goals.
This perspective naturally supports learning, adaptation, generalization, and trade-offs between com-
peting objectives. In modern ML, conceptual representations often emerge implicitly from loss
functions, inductive biases, and training dynamics.
